strata: 8 starts x start cycle lengths 4-5 or 6-8; 16 candidates and 8 selections per stratum per round
static: lowest salted map hashes within each stratum
adaptive: per stratum take five boundary, two failure, one mastered. Boundary = imperfect trajectory with 4 or 5 correct prefix hops or disagreement across orders; rank by proximity of average correct terminal probability to 0.5. Failure = other imperfect paths; rank by longest correct prefix. Mastered = both paths correct; rank by lower terminal confidence. Fill deficits from remaining boundary, failure, mastered in that order. Stable map ID ties.
objective: mean CE over all executed state labels per map
initial_optimizer: fresh AdamW for both branches, preserve moments into round two
primary: mean terminal sixth-hop accuracy over two frozen shuffled orders, paired map bootstrap 10000 samples
promotion: Final adaptive exceeds static by >=0.03 and adaptive third-hop accuracy falls <=0.02 absolute versus parent. Parent terminal accuracy must be below 0.95. Positive result requires independent seed and total-compute matched static before stronger claims.
stop: After matched round one stop if either branch third-hop drops >0.02 versus parent. Stop on nonfinite, pressure warning, identity mismatch or time cap. No third cycle.
